title: The Best Wildlife Lens Is Knowing What the Animal Will Do Next
excerpt: Sharp focus and a long lens will only take you so far. The photographers who come home with the moment are the ones who studied the animal before they ever raised the camera.

title: The Full-Frame Bubble Has Burst. The Camera You Need Didn't.
excerpt: Full-frame shipments fell as much as 20% this year while smaller cameras held their ground. Buyers are voting for cameras they will actually carry.

title: Shoot Like You Only Have 24 Frames and Watch What Changes
excerpt: A Nikon Zf, a manual lens, and a self-imposed 24-frame limit. The experiment mostly proved how much digital helps, and how much the limit still teaches.
